title: Badla Bandini
synopsis: Seven years ago a fire in the Thakur family's grain warehouse killed three workers. Gauri, the young daughter-in-law who found the ledger proving the family ordered it, was framed for arson and jailed. Released, she returns under the name Kamla as the haveli's new cook, to expose the family one truth at a time. Her father-in-law, Thakur Dalip Singh, is believed to have died five years ago.
content_advisory: emotional cruelty and implied danger, no gore, no strong language
ai_disclosure_note: Story and dialogue written with AI assistance; images, motion, voices and music generated with AI tools.
